terms.quote: Licence (A1, legal floor): feed terms are 'unknown' until legal reviews them, so nothing runs yet in any profile. Legal's feed-reader decision (poll <= hourly; headline + link + date only; no full text; no redistribution) is recorded per kept feed with its class and evidence; a feed whose terms forbid business use or automated reading is dropped.

Feed https://databreaches.net/feed/; read by module cti_news_rss through the dataset manager (TTL 3600 s, conditional GET, 2 MiB cap, <= 200 items; headline + link + date only, descriptions discarded). Live 2026-11-26: 200 RSS, 10 items, ETag + Last-Modified, conditional GET -> 304. Site content (c) DataBreaches.net: headlines + links only.
